Visited Priya Nair at Thermo Engineering Systems today. Thermo is doing the OEM integration work
for Sapcon's instruments on the Reliance Cement project, and Reliance Cement is the end user of
the equipment Thermo is supplying under our name.

Priya also mentioned that a consultant, BuildRight Consultants, recently referred Thermo to a new
project opportunity in Nagpur.

Separately, she said she'd heard through an unnamed distributor contact that Konkan Dairy Products
might be interested in bringing Thermo onto a new plant project, though nothing's confirmed yet.

Priya also flagged that a company called ColdChain Sensors Pvt Ltd has been showing up as a
competitor to us in some of these dairy sector bids.

I need to call Priya back in one week to check if the Konkan Dairy opportunity firms up.
